core_obligations: Etale step: descend-etale makes f_i etale for some i; the image V_i = f_i(X_i) is a quasi-compact open of Y_i (etale-open lemma).

Isomorphism step: f: X -> V (the preimage of V_i) is a surjective open immersion, hence an isomorphism; descend-isomorphism gives X_{i'} -> V_{i'} an isomorphism for some i' >= i; conclude f_{i'} is an open immersion.
proof_roadmap: descend-etale; image is a qc open.
Restriction is a surjective open immersion = isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: descend-etale + the etale-open lemma give a qc open image V_i; the restriction f: X -> V is a surjective open immersion, hence an isomorphism; descend-isomorphism closes. Three-engine assembly.

compared.difference: The sibling is the isomorphism engine (delivered as L30264); this lemma is the open immersion conclusion built on it. Different statements.
